Create ONE entirely NEW Estudário achievement painting from scratch. Reference image 1 is the EXACT FIXED TIER FRAME: preserve its outline, scale, thickness, wreath, crest, gemstones and empty indigo fabric ribbon; paint the scene only in its central opening. Reference image 2 is ONLY the approved Folha identity and collection style, never a pose to copy. Rich dip-pen ink, layered gouache and colored-pencil grain, beautifully controlled warm storytelling light, nuanced pigment and hand-painted edges, polished editorial illustration that reads at 512 px, not plastic 3D or a flat app icon.

FOLHA CONSTRUCTION: a real open indigo hardcover BOOK, two broad gently CURVED cream inner page surfaces with a clear center crease, thin fanned paper edges, small indigo graduation cap and a mint bookmark. Friendly expressive face ON THE INNER PAGES; one eye on each page plane. Maintain a coherent dimensional book with curved leaf corners, not a square box, tablet, suitcase, human torso or face on paper thickness. Exactly TWO SHORT indigo arms of similar proportional length (about one fifth of the book's width), one from each OUTER LATERAL hardcover edge at MID-HEIGHT. Each root is hidden just behind that cover edge; each exposed forearm goes directly to one cream mitten hand. Exactly TWO hands, visibly connected to their two arms. Bring props close rather than stretching arms. No arm from the cap, top, bottom, spine or broad page/cover face; no extra limb, long ribbon arm, loop around the body or detached glove. Folha floats when moving: NO LEGS, FEET, SHOES or human lower body. Keep character and props entirely within the frame opening. Real transparent exterior, ribbon completely EMPTY. No words, letters, numbers, fake text, logos or watermarks anywhere. One complete square badge, no sheet.
